name: profile
description: Creates, validates, and freezes column-scoping profiles for report tools

options.name: explicit
options.description: Show raw data values in output (default: redacted for zero-retention safety)

options.name: out
options.description: Canonical output path flag used by profile-producing commands

options.name: sheet
options.description: Worksheet (name or 0-based index) when the dataset is an .xlsx/.xls workbook; required for a workbook with more than one sheet. Accepted by draft init, lint, stats, suggest-key and slice

options.name: max-arity
options.description: Maximum suggest-key arity (1, 2, or 3); composite tuples use ordered ASCII-trimmed components

options.name: from-peek
options.description: Fingerprint peek JSON used to detect a pre-parse slice shift during profile evolve

options.name: view
options.description: Amount of profile evolve drift detail to emit

commands.name: doctor
commands.description: Read-only diagnostic surface for headless agents

commands.name: capabilities
commands.description: Top-level machine-readable capability contract for headless agents

commands.name: robot-docs
commands.description: Top-level paste-ready operating guide for headless agents

commands.name: draft new
commands.description: Create blank draft template

commands.name: draft init
commands.description: Create draft from dataset header

commands.name: validate
commands.description: Validate profile against schema

commands.name: lint
commands.description: Validate + check against dataset

commands.name: evolve
commands.description: Create a mutable next-version draft from dataset drift and optional peek slice directives

commands.name: slice
commands.description: Apply profile/ad-hoc pre_parse directives and registry-backed canonical CSV headers to emit clean CSV plus optional manifest

commands.name: emit-discovery
commands.description: Emit a profile.discovery.v0 candidate template from an already-sliced CSV

commands.name: emit-verify-starter
commands.description: Emit zero-retention starter verify rules from a frozen profile and optional stats

commands.name: emit-ddl
commands.description: Emit deterministic Postgres or Snowflake DDL from a frozen profile and optional stats

commands.name: stats
commands.description: Deterministic structural stats

commands.name: inspect
commands.description: Single-file structural/statistical inspection; default numeric min/max/p50/p95 are null and --explicit restores exact summaries and examples

commands.name: suggest-key
commands.description: Rank single or ordered composite key candidates with bounded hashed retention and collision diagnostics

commands.name: freeze
commands.description: Freeze draft into immutable profile

commands.name: list
commands.description: List available frozen profiles

commands.name: show
commands.description: Show resolved profile

commands.name: diff
commands.description: Diff two profile versions

commands.name: push
commands.description: Publish a frozen profile to data-fabric (deferred in v0.1)

commands.name: pull
commands.description: Fetch a frozen profile by ID from data-fabric (deferred in v0.1)

commands.name: witness
commands.description: Query the witness ledger

refusals.message: Family/version syntax or integer constraints failed
Dataset missing header or data rows required for operation
Input refused by the shared tabular reader (TSV, JSONL, Parquet, XLSX)
PROFILE_REDACTION_KEY is empty or too short
slice would print the CSV to stdout; pass --out <path> or --explicit
This build has no network support (Cargo feature `network`)

env_vars.name: HOME
env_vars.description: Base directory for profile configuration and state

env_vars.name: EPISTEMIC_FABRIC_URL
env_vars.description: Optional data-fabric endpoint (push and pull exist only in a build with the `network` Cargo feature)

env_vars.name: SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH
env_vars.description: Unix timestamp for reproducible witness records

env_vars.name: PROFILE_REDACTION_KEY
env_vars.description: Optional operator key (at least 16 bytes) for keyed HMAC-SHA256 header markers; unset gives ordinal refs; an empty or short key refuses with E_REDACTION_KEY_INVALID

side_effects.notes: doctor, capabilities, and robot-docs are read-only; profile operations write only requested artifacts, witness records, or configured network endpoints

column_registry_hash.framing: registry.json first, then sorted direct *.json mapping files excluding registry.json and _build.json; each frame is relative_path NUL byte_len NUL file_bytes 0xFF
